name: Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon (9th ed.)
short_description: The 9th Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon takes place on December 6, 2026, in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with registration open.
ai_summary: The Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon returns for its 9th edition on December 6, 2026, taking place in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The event offers four distance options: a full marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), a 10 km race, and a 5 km race. Registration is currently open for runners interested in participating in this international road race.
pros: Multiple distance options (5 km, 10 km, half marathon, full marathon) suit runners of different levels
Registration is currently open, giving prospective participants time to plan and train

faqs.question: When is the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon held?
faqs.answer: This event, now in its 9th edition, is scheduled to take place on December 6, 2026. It will be held in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, offering runners a full year or more to prepare, register, and plan their travel to this international race destination.

faqs.question: What distances can I run in this event?
faqs.answer: The race offers four distance categories to accommodate different runner abilities and goals: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, a 10 km race, and a shorter 5 km race, making it accessible to both competitive and casual participants.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is currently open. Prospective participants can sign up now for any of the four available distances ahead of the race date of December 6, 2026, in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

faqs.question: Where does the marathon take place?
faqs.answer: The marathon takes place in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, which serves as both the host city and venue for this international road race. Runners traveling from abroad or within Vietnam will find the event centered in this major city on December 6, 2026.
